description: This file contains utility functions for testing SPDY protocol frames, including hex dump formatting, comparison with error reporting, and frame manipulation functions.

methods.name: HexDumpWithMarks
methods.description: Generates a hex dump string of data with optional marks indicating specific bytes.

methods.name: CompareCharArraysWithHexError
methods.description: Compares two byte arrays and reports detailed hex dump differences if they differ.

methods.name: SetFrameFlags
methods.description: Sets the flags byte in a SPDY serialized frame.

methods.name: SetFrameLength
methods.description: Sets the length field in a SPDY serialized frame, ensuring it fits within protocol limits.
